cases.title: Select Available Seat
cases.description: Verify that clicking on an available seat marks it as selected and updates the selected seat count in data-testid="selected-count".

cases.title: Select Movie from Dropdown
cases.description: Verify that selecting a movie from data-testid="movie-select" updates the ticket price based on the option's value.

cases.title: Calculate Total Price
cases.description: Verify that the total price shown in data-testid="total-price" is calculated as the number of selected seats multiplied by the selected movie's price.

cases.title: Prevent Occupied Seat Selection
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as occupied cannot be selected and do not affect the seat count or total price.

cases.title: Dynamic Price Update on Movie Change
cases.description: Verify that changing the selected movie at any time dynamically updates the total price accordingly.

cases.title: Select a movie from the dropdown menu and verify price update
cases.description: Verify that a user can select a movie from the dropdown menu (e.g., 'The Big Lebowski ($10)', 'Fargo ($12)', 'O Brother ($8)', and 'No Country for Old Men ($9)', each identified by a specific data-testid) and its price updates accordingly.

cases.title: Click available seat to toggle selection status and store in localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking on an available seat (identified by data-testid="seat-1-1") toggles the seat's selection status, visually marks it as selected, and stores its index in localStorage.

cases.title: Dynamic update of seat count and total price
cases.description: Verify that the seat count (data-testid="selected-count") and total price (data-testid="total-price") dynamically update based on the number of selected seats and the chosen movie's price.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as 'occupied' cannot be selected or included in the calculation.

cases.title: Deselect previously selected seats and update UI and localStorage
cases.description: Verify that users can deselect previously selected seats by clicking on them again, and the UI, along with localStorage, updates accordingly.

cases.title: Restore selected seats and movie selection from local storage
cases.description: Verify that when local storage contains 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', the system marks the corresponding seats with the 'selected' class and sets the movie dropdown to the correct option.

cases.title: Default to initial state when local storage is empty
cases.description: Verify that when local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', no seats are marked as 'selected' and the dropdown defaults to 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Set ticket price from movie select
cases.description: Verify that when the user selects a movie from the dropdown menu with data-testid 'movie-select', the ticket price is set according to the selected movie's value.

cases.title: Toggle selected class on available seats
cases.description: Verify that as the user clicks on available seats (those without the 'occupied' class) within the seating area, the system toggles the 'selected' class on the clicked seat.

cases.title: Update selected count and total price
cases.description: Verify that the count of selected seats displayed with data-testid 'selected-count' updates to reflect the current number of seats with the 'selected' class, and the total price displayed with data-testid 'total-price' is calculated as the product of the number of selected seats and the current ticket price.

cases.title: Decrease count and total price on deselection
cases.description: Verify that if a user deselects a seat by clicking on it again, the count and total price decrease accordingly.

cases.title: Update total price on movie change with existing seat count
cases.description: Verify that if the user changes the movie selection after selecting seats, the total price updates based on the new ticket price while maintaining the count of selected seats.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that the system prevents users from selecting seats marked as 'occupied'.

cases.title: Verify seat status legends and availability
cases.description: Verify that legends correctly indicate the status of available, selected, and occupied seats, ensuring occupied seats are non-interactive and available seats can be clicked to toggle selection while updating the count and total price.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1: Multiple distinct behaviors including seat selection, count update, movie selection, total price calculation, prevention of occupied seat selection, and dynamic price updating upon movie change. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2: Multiple distinct behaviors including movie selection with specific options, price updating, seat selection toggling with local storage persistence, dynamic count and price updates, prevention of occupied seat selection, and deselection capability updating UI and local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3: Multiple distinct behaviors including retrieval from localStorage for 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', applying 'selected' class and dropdown selection, and fallback behavior to default values when localStorage keys are absent. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4: Multiple distinct behaviors covering dynamic display of count and price, setting ticket price from 'movie-select', toggling 'selected' class on available seats, updating 'selected-count' and 'total-price', decreasing values on deselection, updating total price on movie change with existing seat count, and preventing occupied seat selection. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5: Multiple distinct behaviors including displaying legends for seat statuses, ensuring occupied seats are non-interactive, allowing available seats to be clicked for toggle, and updating count and total price on selection/deselection.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1 contains multiple behaviors: clicking an available seat marks it as selected, updating the selected count at data-testid="selected-count", selecting a movie via data-testid="movie-select", calculating total price at data-testid="total-price" as selected seats multiplied by ticket price, preventing occupied seat selection, and dynamically updating total price upon changing the movie. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2 contains multiple behaviors: selecting a movie from options with specific data-testids, updating the movie price, toggling seat selection status on click, storing selected indices in localStorage, dynamically updating seat count and total price, preventing selection of occupied seats, and deselecting seats by clicking again to update the UI and localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3 contains multiple behaviors: retrieving and applying 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' from localStorage on load, applying the 'selected' class and setting the dropdown, and defaulting to no selected seats and the first movie option when localStorage keys are absent. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4 contains multiple behaviors: dynamically displaying seat count and total price, setting ticket price from 'movie-select', toggling 'selected' class on available seats, updating 'selected-count' and 'total-price', decreasing count and price on deselection, updating total price on movie change while maintaining seat count, and preventing selection of occupied seats. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5 contains multiple distinct behaviors: displaying legends for seat statuses (including data-testid = 'seat-select'), ensuring occupied seats are non-interactive, allowing available seats to be clicked to toggle selection, and updating the selected count and total price when users select or deselect seats (covered normal and deselect behaviors).

qualitative.rationale: Candidate round-1-candidate-3 successfully addresses the coverage gap identified in the previous round by explicitly adding a test case (G-020) for seat deselection associated with requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5, ensuring all scenarios are thoroughly covered.

output.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1 contains multiple behaviors: clicking an available seat marks it as selected, updating the selected count at data-testid="selected-count", selecting a movie via data-testid="movie-select", calculating total price at data-testid="total-price" as selected seats multiplied by ticket price, preventing occupied seat selection, and dynamically updating total price upon changing the movie. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2 contains multiple behaviors: selecting a movie from options with specific data-testids, updating the movie price, toggling seat selection status on click, storing selected indices in localStorage, dynamically updating seat count and total price, preventing selection of occupied seats, and deselecting seats by clicking again to update the UI and localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3 contains multiple behaviors: retrieving and applying 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' from localStorage on load, applying the 'selected' class and setting the dropdown, and defaulting to no selected seats and the first movie option when localStorage keys are absent. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4 contains multiple behaviors: dynamically displaying seat count and total price, setting ticket price from 'movie-select', toggling 'selected' class on available seats, updating 'selected-count' and 'total-price', decreasing count and price on deselection, updating total price on movie change while maintaining seat count, and preventing selection of occupied seats. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5 contains multiple distinct behaviors: displaying legends for seat statuses (including data-testid = 'seat-select'), ensuring occupied seats are non-interactive, allowing available seats to be clicked to toggle selection, and updating the selected count and total price when users select or deselect seats (covered normal and deselect behaviors).
